conditions: 6 AM—Greetings on a fantastic Friday morning here in the Tetons. The weekend may not be here officially, but starting it off early may just alleviate your ongoing dopamine deficiency. The sun will be sharing the sky with some scattered clouds, slowly warming cool morning temperatures back into the mid-30s at the summit and the mid-50s in the base area. Gentle southwest winds will barely breeze more than 5 mph. Live music and liquid refreshments for the final day on our Road to Rendezvous will bolster the springtime celebrational vibe. So, holster any negativity and treat your spirit to a sublime levitational ride. -Lege
